content:
Day One Arrival in Tokyo  
Thou dost land at Narita Airport ere the sun doth rise.  
Take the express train to thy lodging in Shibuya.  
Wander the bustling streets where neon lights doth gleam.  
Visit the Meiji Shrine where tranquil woods doth whisper.  
Enjoy a humble repast of sushi at an izakaya ere nightfall.  

Day Two Exploration of Tokyo  
Morning find thou at the Tsukiji Outer Market sampling fresh fare.  
Afternoon ascend the Tokyo Tower to behold the city sprawl.  
Evening stroll through Harajuku where youthful fashion doth thrive.  
Night visit the Shibuya Crossing where myriad souls doth converge.  

Day Three Journey to Kyoto  
Board the shinkansen at dawn swift as an arrow.
